fields.why: Table 1 compares vaccination coverage across 3+ SPD groups (age, race/ethnicity, education, insurance) with outcomes measured per group.
Age (3 groups), race/ethnicity (4), education (3) and insurance (3) each have 3+ groups compared; marital, working and poverty status are 2-level.
Each level is judged only against a § reference group by the stated ≥5 percentage-point rule (Table 1 * mark); no omnibus or all-pairs assessment.

brief_issues: The brief does not name a fixed difference-threshold rule (≥5 pp vs referent) as an assessment type; per-group vs referent only fits by analogy with ratios against a reference level.
